frame.definition: Topic frame for the DAS adoption quantity of proposal Comment 4: every OpenAlex work typed article or review whose title or abstract matches the quoted phrase, 2020-2025. Same filter as the frozen 2026-10-21 group_by snapshot in data/openalex/2026-10-21/manifest.json, retrieved as records instead of counts.

credential_note: Optional existing user-provided verified key only. Never create keys/accounts. Cursor pagination beyond the first page of each year stops without a key.
coverage_note: A topic frame counts indexed works that name the phrase; it is not a journal census, not all DAS research, and says nothing about actual use or users. The AI-as-method share from the semantic screen uses this AI-free denominator.
